verdict.rationale: The official Go SDK exposes CheckWithContext for checking availability of multiple domains at once, showing some batch capability, but other SDK/API operations (Create, Renew, SetRegistrarLock, Terraform provider) are documented as single-item calls with no evidence of bulk registration, renewal, or DNS record updates across many items. missing for 10: bulk create/renew/lock endpoints, bulk DNS record management, and any hands-on confirmation that large-scale bulk operations work reliably.
